title: SAE Causality Analysis
summary: This module provides tools for analyzing the causal impact of specific SAE features on model activations, including decoding sparse latent representations and applying causal intervention hooks.

nodes.label: Decode Sparse Latent Direction
nodes.title: Decode Sparse Latent Direction
nodes.description: Decodes a sparse latent representation (z) from an SAE into a dense direction vector, with an option to unit-normalize the output.

nodes.label: Apply Causal Intervention Hook
nodes.title: Apply Causal Intervention Hook
nodes.description: Implements a PyTorch hook to intervene on model activations. It identifies and subtracts the contribution of specified SAE features from the activation tensor, enabling causal analysis.

nodes.label: SAE Experiment Runner
nodes.title: SAE Experiment Runner
nodes.description: Orchestrates various experiments with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), including ablation studies and reconstruction tasks.

groups.label: Causal Analysis Tools
groups.title: Causal Analysis Tools
groups.description: Core components for performing causal interventions and interpreting SAE feature contributions.
